engine_rules_needed: Escrow-only books: for cash-basis entities where escrow funding is the ONLY tax/insurance record (lender pays from escrow), excluding the escrow lines zeroes out taxes/insurance and inflates NOI — the engine needs a rule to derive tax/insurance expense from escrow disbursements or lender statements for those entities. Related: confirm 'Mortgage Payment' 7405 is P&I only, not PITI; if escrow is embedded, taxes/insurance silently leak out of opex.

Replacement Units and Parts (both charts, classified opex low-confidence): name says replacement units — pull GL detail and split whole-unit replacements (capex) from parts/consumables (opex); a blanket opex call mixes capital into NOI, a blanket capex call strips real R&M.

Turnover/Rehab 6830 (classified ti): if this account also carries ordinary make-ready (cleaning, patch/paint), the blanket TI classification removes recurring turnover opex from NOI and inflates it — split by ticket scope.

Asset Management Fees (excluded): confirm this is a true owner-level AM fee and not the entity's de facto property-management fee; if no separate PM fee exists on that entity's books, exclusion inflates NOI and violates the management-fee convention.

Prepaid Rental Income (excluded, both charts): confirm basis of accounting — on cash-basis books this is often actual collected rent, and exclusion understates revenue/NOI; exclusion is only right on accrual books where it is a deferral.
Insurance Reimbursement 5092: tenant insurance billback (recovery, in NOI) vs carrier claim proceeds (exclude) — GL detail decides; claim proceeds in NOI would overstate it.

PY Real Estate Tax / PY Insurance: verify these sit in the INCOME chart as recovery true-ups and are not prior-year EXPENSE adjustments — a sign flip here double-corrupts NOI (adds as income what should subtract as expense).

Bad Debt Expense (booked contra-income in two charts, classified opex): pick one normalization for sign — if the extractor ingests it with income-section sign AND the engine subtracts it as opex, it will be double-counted or added back.
Tax Refund: RE tax refund nets against Taxes (in NOI); entity income-tax refund is excluded — classification as other-income is wrong in both readings if material; resolve from GL detail.

Tax - Other and Tax -- Md State: confirm license/franchise/gross-receipts (opex) vs income/PTE tax (excluded); note MD property bills include a small state real-property tax component, so blanket exclusion of 'Md State' could drop a true property-tax cost.

Professional-fee family with capitalization risk flagged at low confidence — Survey 6145, Appraisal 6020, Engineer 6060, Environmental 6065, Architects Fee 6575, Consultant Fee (both charts): pull GL detail once and rule acquisition/refi/project-tied fees to capex, recurring compliance/tax-appeal work to opex; current per-account guesses are unstable.
Electricity Income -- PS: confirm solar power-sales (other-income, arguably non-real-estate) vs tenant electric billback (recovery); also decide whether solar income belongs in stabilized NOI at all.

Tenant Improvement Reimbursement: confirm direction — landlord-funded allowance (expense-side, ti is correct) vs tenant reimbursing landlord for capital work (income-side; still out of NOI but sign and capex-netting differ).
